versions.content: Transformation of BSWMD template modeling according to the AUTOSAR XML Schema Production Rules Type: valid Description: The XML representation for the BSWMD template SHALL be derived from its UML representation according to the AUTOSAR XML Schema Production Rules. Rationale: The experience and tools already available for the AUTOSAR Modeling SHALL be reused. Dependencies: – Use Case: The template for the BSWMD is similar to other templates already done with the AUTOSAR Metamodeling Guide. Supporting Material: AUTOSAR XML Schema Production Rules [5]
